title: Ordinary coordinates of the finite coefficient Hom transpose
statement: Let $X$ be any scheme, $\ell$ a prime, $E/\mathbf Q_\ell$ a finite extension, and $n\ge m\ge0$. Use the positive coefficient rings $A=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{n+1})$ and $B=\mathcal O_E/(\varpi_E^{m+1})$ and their actual quotient $\varphi$ [def-weil-l-adic-coefficient-extension, def-sf-etale-finite-coefficient-hom-arrow]. For arbitrary objects $K,M$ of the ambient small-etale derived category of $A$-module sheaves, the right-tensor evaluation-defined arrow etaleFiniteHomCanonical equals CoefficientPairingChange.evaluationComparison as an Arrow object, including both endpoint objects and the map. The latter is the transpose along the ordinary left-tensor derived tensor-Hom adjunction of its tensor comparison followed by scalar extension of the ordinary evaluation counit [def-coef-internal-adjunction-comparison-maps]. No boundedness or invertibility is asserted.

proof.text: The scalar tensorator normalization identifies its inverse with etaleHomTensorComparison in ordinary tensor coordinates. The signed scalar symmetry square moves the interchange through scalar extension. Both proposed arrows therefore untranspose to exactly that ordinary tensor comparison followed by scalar extension of the evaluation counit. Injectivity of the left-tensor Hom equivalence proves equality. This uses arbitrary complexes, including zero inputs and identity quotients.

lean.statement:
theorem finiteHom_ordinary_transpose
    (l : ℕ) [Fact l.Prime] (E : Type u) [Field E] [Algebra (Padic l) E]
    [FiniteDimensional (Padic l) E] (X : Scheme.{u}) {n m : ℕ} (h : m ≤ n)
    (K M : finiteHomEtale l E X n) :
    Arrow.mk (etaleFiniteHomCanonical l E X h K M) =
      Arrow.mk (Etale.CoefficientPairingChange.evaluationComparison
        (finiteHomQuotient l E h) X K M)
